title: Jagged Savory Italian Vegetable Ribollita
description: A savory and adventurous Italian dish featuring Branston pickle, tandoor spices, and ayurvedic-rajasic friendly ingredients in a hearty ribollita form, with a shattering crunch from toasted bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Toss the cubed bread with olive oil and toast in the oven for 10 minutes
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the diced celery and carrots for 5 minutes
Add the chopped kale and cook until wilted
Add the diced zucchini and cook for an additional 2 minutes
Add the canned diced tomatoes, tandoor spice mix, and chopped Branston pickle to the pot
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the ribollita for 20 minutes
Stir in the toasted bread cubes and cook for an additional 2 minutes
Serve the ribollita hot, garnished with additional toasted bread cubes if desired
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
